component.name: Crossparty
component.summary: Unofficial desktop app for Xbox party chat

description.p: Crossparty puts Xbox party chat from the web in its own desktop window, with an overlay you can open over your games and a full-screen layout for handhelds in Steam's Game Mode.

ul.li: Mute your microphone with a hotkey, with a badge while you are muted
A small alert when a party invite arrives while you are in a game
Only Microsoft's own sites load inside the app; every other link opens in your browser
Your sign-in is stored encrypted, and one action signs out and erases it
No telemetry, analytics or crash reporting

description.p: Crossparty is an unofficial project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Microsoft. Xbox is a trademark of Microsoft Corporation.

Controllers work with no setup: the D-pad or left stick moves, A selects and B goes back, only while Crossparty is the app in front. In handheld mode, the Menu button reaches Mute and Sign Out. Going back never reloads the party.
The first release: party chat in a KDE window, a mute hotkey with a muted badge, an overlay above games, invite alerts, a handheld mode for Steam's Game Mode, and Sign out and wipe.
